title: Card shuffle
description: One card that flips through variants of its picture — colourways, styles, takes — faster and faster, holds for a breath, then lands on the last one with a pop while its name rolls in underneath. For 'pick a look', 'every style', options or before/after beats. Give media_1 to media_6 (bin file ids); without them a drawn character in different colourways is used.

media_1.description: Variant 1 of the card's picture (file id).

media_2.description: Variant 2 of the card's picture (file id).

media_3.description: Variant 3 of the card's picture (file id).

media_4.description: Variant 4 of the card's picture (file id).

media_5.description: Variant 5 of the card's picture (file id).

media_6.description: Variant 6 of the card's picture (file id).

names.description: A name under the card for each variant, in order (empty: no names).

variants.description: How many variants it flips through when no media is given (with media: one per given file; a single file flips onto itself).
